name: MACD EA
summary: This EA trades based on MACD crossover signals, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line and entering short positions when MACD crosses below. It uses configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels for risk management. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach relying on MACD histogram and signal line interactions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD交叉信号进行交易，当MACD向上穿越信号线时做多，向下穿越信号线时做空。它使用可配置的手数和止损/止盈水平进行风险管理。该策略是经典的动量跟踪方法，依赖MACD柱状图和信号线的交互。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的MACD动量交叉策略，核心概念是利用MACD指标的金叉和死叉来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉——金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈参数，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数方式，用户通过InpLotSize参数设定每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔亏损上限，但未见基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic MACD momentum crossover strategy, with the core concept of using MACD golden cross and death cross signals to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are based on MACD main line crossing the signal line — golden cross for long entries, death cross for short entries. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit parameters, and may also close positions when an opposing crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the lot size through the InpLotSize parameter. Money management includes a stop loss parameter to cap per-trade losses, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or balance. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
使用MACD经典指标，理论基础扎实，广泛应用于技术分析
提供止损和止盈参数，具备基本的风险控制能力
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Uses the well-established MACD indicator with solid theoretical foundation widely used in technical analysis
Provides stop loss and take profit parameters with basic risk control capability
cons: 固定手数仓位管理，无法根据账户资金动态调整风险敞口
MACD在震荡行情中容易产生大量虚假信号导致频繁亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
cons_en: Fixed lot position sizing cannot dynamically adjust risk exposure based on account equity
MACD tends to generate numerous false signals in ranging markets leading to frequent losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Lacks spread filter, entry costs may be too high in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算手数
添加趋势过滤条件（如大周期均线方向），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
增加新K线检查和点差过滤，提高交易质量和减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing to automatically calculate lot size based on account balance and risk ratio
Add trend filter conditions (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Add new bar check and spread filter to improve trade quality and reduce false signals

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致过度持仓
固定手数无法适应不同账户规模，小账户风险可能过高
MACD滞后性导致入场不及时，止损可能频繁触发
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar leading to overexposure
Fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes, risk may be too high for small accounts
MACD lag causes delayed entries, stop losses may be frequently triggered

It uses configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels for risk management. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach relying on MACD histogram and signal line interactions.
